description: This file provides a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' to convert raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It handles normalization of input, replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and applies title casing, preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label, formatting and title-casing the input appropriately.
